title: tephrosia aurantiaca subsp. lutea
intro: Tephrosia aurantiaca subsp. lutea, commonly known as the golden parkinsonia or parkinsonia, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae, characterized by its bright yellow flowers and ability to grow in arid regions. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as wounds, infections, and skin diseases. The therapeutic actions of Tephrosia aurantiaca subsp. lutea include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant contribute to its medicinal properties, showcasing its potential as a natural remedy for various health issues.
